hearing.title: Synthetic speech: multiple bills and conditional support

segments.speaker: Speaker A
segments.text: This is Senator Linden. This fictional hearing covers H.8102 and S.8103. The bills concern application notices. Please distinguish your position on each bill and keep any conditions clear. These recordings are generated test fixtures rather than a real committee hearing.

segments.speaker: Speaker B
segments.text: I'm Elise Turner with Example Neighborhood Desk. I support H.8102 only if the emergency repair exemption is added. Without that exemption, a family might miss the deadline while dealing with an urgent repair. My support is conditional, and the condition should not disappear from the notes.

segments.speaker: Speaker B
segments.text: I oppose S.8103 in its current form because it removes the mailed copy. Some applicants cannot reliably receive an electronic message. A nearby group has said it supports that bill, but that is their position, not mine. Keep a printed delivery option before advancing it.

segments.speaker: Speaker A
segments.text: Would a translated copy address your concern about S.8103?

segments.speaker: Speaker B
segments.text: Translation would help, but it would not replace paper delivery. I would reconsider the bill if both options were retained. I have not changed my position on the current version. That is the end of this fictional test testimony.
